_comment: Copy to approved_versions.json (next to node_worker.py) to use. Read when the node starts.
policy 'latest' (default): install the newest version; it must be at least the version Qualys requires.
policy 'exact': install the required version from the finding, or 'version' if IT approved a specific one.
1st try: winget, pinned to that version.
2nd try: 'installer' — an installer IT downloaded and tested, run only if its SHA256 matches 'sha256'.
Otherwise nothing is installed and the item stays open as 'approved version not available'.
Get a file's SHA256 with:  certutil -hashfile <file> SHA256
